C0939.title: Haier Consumer Finance, Duxiaoman, and Meituan Assist Police in Busting Large-Scale 'Anti-Collection' Fraud Case
C0939.summary: Zhengzhou police dismantled a criminal gang centered on a legal consulting company. Under the banners of anti-collection, proxy rights protection, and debt optimization, the gang defrauded numerous online microloan borrowers and was linked to an upstream group that forged official government document seals. The case shows that anti-collection black and gray markets can package themselves as legal services, forge documents, and induce payments, harming borrowers and financial institutions.

references.title: Haier Consumer Finance Assists Police in Busting Large-Scale 'Anti-Collection' Financial Black-Market Fraud Case (Economic Daily)
